acceptance_criteria.statement: WHEN the export corpus is replayed, THE SYSTEM SHALL produce output byte-identical to the recorded baseline.

declared_edges.statement: The exporter reads and writes objects through the storage client.

decisions.statement: Ship behind the existing release train; no separate deployment.

approval.reason: Adding a dependency is an architectural change.
approval.subject: dependency-addition

commands.reason: Recorded here as DATA. Nothing in this system executes a command string from a contract - the same standard CORE-029 sets for verification commands.
commands.subject: rm -rf /

filesystem_protected.reason: History is evidence. An agent that can rewrite it can erase what it did.
filesystem_protected.subject: .git/**

filesystem_read.reason: Reading the repository is how the work is understood.

filesystem_write.reason: Infrastructure changes are reviewed by the platform team before they land.
filesystem_write.subject: infra/**

intent.business_outcome: Remove the last dependency on the retired storage SDK before its end of life.
intent.description: FIXTURE DATA - not product evidence. Carries an execution_policy: the boundary on the DEVELOPMENT AGENT implementing this contract, not the runtime permissions of the built system.
intent.name: Migrate the reporting exporter to the new storage client

non_goals.rationale: A content change during a client swap is indistinguishable from a defect.
non_goals.statement: Exported report contents must not change.

requirements.rationale: Byte-identical output is the only check strong enough to prove a pure client swap.
requirements.statement: Every export MUST produce byte-identical output to the pre-migration baseline.

scope.statement: Replace every call to the retired storage SDK with the new client.

verification.description: Stored as data. This system never executes it.
verification.name: Export golden replay
